integrity: The theorem is proved analytically from arbitrary slices and continuity of the absolute norm; no finite experiment is used to infer an infinite-dimensional statement.
limitations: The general theorem assumes strictness on both coordinate axes of the absolute normalized norm; partially flat absolute norms are not classified.
The \(\ell_p\)-corollary covers \(1\le p<\infty\) and sums with at least two nonzero summands; no claim is made for \(p=\infty\) or for a one-summand space.
No claim is made about the nonsymmetric properties \(\mathrm{SD}(d)\mathrm P\) or \(\mathrm{LD}(d)\mathrm P\).
The literature comparison cannot exclude an unindexed equivalent statement under substantially different terminology.
title: Axis-strict absolute sums have no positive symmetric strong diameter scale
